create_RGB2YUV: create an RGB2YUV nn.Module to convert batched RGB images to YUV color space
create_YUV2RGB: create a YUV2RGB nn.Module to convert batched YUV images back to RGB color space
run_rgb_to_yuv: run the rgb_to_yuv function to convert a batched tensor from RGB to YUV format
run_yuv_to_rgb: run the yuv_to_rgb function to convert a batched tensor from YUV to RGB format
build_get_transforms: build training and validation transforms with resize, crop, color jitter, and random flip
